name: Medici: Sealed Ledgers
summary: Over 3 days the active player picks a lot of 1 to 3 revealed goods cards, everyone bids for it in a sealed auction, the best ships each day are paid, and at the end good majorities and secret favoured goods are paid. Most florins wins.

player.meaning: Florins held. This is the score, and only its owner sees it.
Secret favoured good (Grain, Cloth, Spice or Dye). Every player has a different one, and it is revealed at game end.
This round's sealed bid. It is set to 0 if the bid is invalid.
Cards loaded on the ship today.
Sum of the card values on the ship today.
Number of cards on the ship today (at most 5).
Grain cards collected over the whole game.
Cloth cards collected over the whole game.
Spice cards collected over the whole game.
Dye cards collected over the whole game.
Total cards collected over the game. This is the tie-break.

game.initial: 48 cards: Grain-0, Grain-1, Grain-1, Grain-2, Grain-2, Grain-3, Grain-3, Grain-3, Grain-4, Grain-4, Grain-5, Grain-5, and the same 12 values for Cloth, Spice and Dye
game.meaning: Today's shuffled deck. A draw takes a card at random.
Cards A, B and C revealed this round, in order.
The cards on offer this round.
Today's unchosen revealed cards and unsold lots.
Number of cards in the lot (1 to 3).
Sum of the card values in the lot.
The active player, equal to ((round-1) mod N)+1.
Seat that won this round's lot (0 if nobody did).

setup: Every player gets 40 florins, which only that player can see.
The four goods Grain, Cloth, Spice and Dye are shuffled. Each player is secretly dealt a different one as favoured_good, without replacement.
Seats are numbered 1 to N. round=1, day=1 and active_seat=1.
Ship cards, ship_value, ship_count, the four good counts and total_cards all start empty or at 0.

round.effect: If round mod (2N) == 1 (first round of a day), deck is rebuilt as all 48 cards, discard is emptied, and every ship_cards, ship_value and ship_count is reset to empty or 0. Then active_seat = ((round-1) mod N)+1, and winner_seat and price_paid are set to 0.
Three cards are drawn at random from deck, in order, into revealed as cards A, B and C, and removed from deck.
Day {day}, round {round}: the active seat is {active_seat}. The revealed cards A, B, C are {revealed}.

lot_size is set to the choice. lot = the first lot_size cards of revealed, and lot_value is set to the sum of their values. The remaining revealed cards are appended to discard, and revealed is emptied.
The lot is {lot} ({lot_size} cards, total value {lot_value}).

round.answer: a whole number from 0 to your own florins (0 is a pass)
round.effect: Each player's bid is set to their answer. Bids stay hidden from the other players.
For each player: if ship_count + lot_size > 5, then bid is set to 0.

If every bid is 0, the lot is appended to discard and winner_seat stays 0. Otherwise winner_seat is the seat with the highest bid, with ties broken by priority = N - ((seat - active_seat + N) mod N). This makes the active seat highest, then the seats after it in order. price_paid is set to the winner's bid.

If winner_seat > 0: the winner loses price_paid florins, the lot is appended to their ship_cards, ship_value rises by lot_value, ship_count rises by lot_size, and total_cards rises by lot_size. grain_count, cloth_count, spice_count and dye_count each rise by the number of lot cards of that good. lot is then emptied.
Winner: seat {winner_seat} paid {price_paid} florins (seat 0 means the lot was discarded). Ship card counts of every seat: {ship_count}. Florins are not announced.

If round mod (2N) == 0 (end of a day), day scoring is applied. Let top = max ship_value. If top > 0 and exactly one player has top, that player gains 15. If k>1 players have top, each gains floor(22/k) and no second place is paid. If exactly one player has top, let second = the highest ship_value below top. If second > 0, the m players with second each gain floor(7/m). Then every ship_cards, ship_value and ship_count is reset to empty or 0, discard is emptied, and day rises by 1.

If round == 6N (after day 3 scoring), majorities are paid. For each of grain_count, cloth_count, spice_count and dye_count: let M = the max over players. If M > 0, the j players with M each gain floor(10/j). Then each player gains 3 × their count of their own favoured_good.
If round == 6N, every player's favoured_good is revealed to everyone.
If round > 6N, the game ends. Otherwise the next round begins.

ending.decided_by: The player with the most florins after end-of-game scoring wins. A tie on florins goes to the tied player with more total cards collected over the game. Players still tied share the win, which is the draw.

rules.text: When the game starts, then every player has 40 florins, visible only to that player.
When the game starts, then each player holds a different favoured good drawn at random from Grain, Cloth, Spice and Dye, known only to that player.
When a day starts (round mod 2N == 1), then the deck is rebuilt as 48 cards: 12 per good, with values 0,1,1,2,2,3,3,3,4,4,5,5.
When it is round r, then the active seat is ((r-1) mod N)+1.
When the game has N players, then each day has 2N rounds and the game has 6N rounds: 18 with 3 players, 24 with 4.
When a round starts, then 3 cards are drawn from the deck and revealed in order as A, B and C.
When the active player chooses lot size 1, 2 or 3, then the lot is A, A+B or A+B+C, and the unchosen revealed cards are discarded.
When bidding happens, then all players, including the active player, bid at the same time a whole number from 0 to their own current florins, and 0 is a pass.
When a player's ship_count + lot_size > 5, then that player's bid is treated as 0.
When one valid bid above 0 is strictly highest, then that bidder wins the lot.
When the highest valid bids tie and the active player is among them, then the active player wins.
When the highest valid bids tie without the active player, then the tied player who comes first in seat order after the active seat wins.
When every bid is 0, then the lot is discarded and nobody pays.

When a player wins a lot with bid b, then their florins fall by b, ship_value rises by the sum of the lot's card values, ship_count and total_cards rise by the lot size, and each good count rises by that good's cards in the lot.
When a round ends, then the winner, the price paid and every player's ship_count are announced, and florins are not announced.
When a day ends and one player alone has the highest ship value (above 0), then that player gains 15 florins.
When a day ends and k>1 players tie for the highest ship value (above 0), then each gains floor(22/k) florins and no second place is paid.
When a day ends with a single leader, then the m players with the second-highest ship value (above 0) each gain floor(7/m) florins.
When a player's ship value is 0 at day end, then that player earns nothing from day scoring.
When day scoring is done, then all ships are emptied (value 0, count 0), and the game-long good counts are kept.
When the game ends, then for each good the j players with the most cards of it (more than 0) each gain floor(10/j) florins, and a good nobody collected pays nothing.
When the game ends, then each player gains 3 florins per card of their favoured good collected, and favoured goods are revealed.
When round 6N has been completed, then the game ends.
When the game ends, then the player with the most florins wins, a tie goes to more total_cards, and players still tied share the win.

offers.question: Sealed bid
offers.who: every seat, including the active seat
offers.options: any whole number from 0 to that seat's current florins. A seat whose ship cannot hold the lot is still asked, but its bid counts as 0.

choices.why: The designer chose 4. 3 is the least where a sealed auction has real rivals and both day prizes are contested. More than 4 is impossible because only 4 favoured goods can be dealt, and majorities would get too thin.
The source says there is no talk. Bidding is sealed and simultaneous, so it is a poll.

choices.what: Tie-break order computed as priority = N - ((seat - active_seat + N) mod N)
choices.why: This turns 'active player first, then seats after the active player' into arithmetic.
The good and the value are both needed for the counts and the ship value.

choices.what: Card values given as the number of copies of each value per good, and round counts given per player (2 per day, 6 per game)
choices.why: Parameters must be plain numbers. 1,2,2,3,2,2 copies of values 0 to 5 give the 12-card distribution, and rounds = 2N per day and 6N in total.
Lots and winners are announced, so ship contents are public knowledge. Only florins, bids and favoured goods are secret.

choices.what: Second place is computed only among ship values above 0 and strictly below the top
choices.why: The source says a value of 0 earns nothing and a tied first place cancels second place.
total_cards cannot reach 1000, so florins decide first and cards break ties. Any remaining tie shares the win, which is the draw.

simplifications.what: The deck rebuild and ship emptying at a day boundary are done by conditional updates on round, at the start of a day and at its end
simplifications.why: The step list is flat, so day transitions use if-conditions on round.

simplifications.what: Favoured goods are revealed by a public tell at the end of the game
simplifications.why: The attribute stays private to its owner, so the reveal is an announcement.
